title: cert-manager and platform issuers
description: The platform's cert-manager ClusterIssuers: an internal self-signed CA chain and an optional public ACME issuer solving HTTP-01 through the Gateway API edge. Requires cert-manager to be installed first (the cert-manager blueprint).

internalCA.title: Internal CA
internalCA.description: Self-signed CA chain used as the platform trust anchor. Certificates issued by it are not publicly trusted.

acme.title: Public ACME issuer
acme.description: Publicly trusted certificates via ACME (Let's Encrypt), solving HTTP-01 through the Gateway API edge. Requires a reachable Gateway and correct public DNS before it can succeed.

email.title: ACME account email
email.description: Required when enabled. Let's Encrypt sends expiry notices here.

acmeDns01.title: ACME issuer (DNS-01)
acmeDns01.description: A second ACME ClusterIssuer solving DNS-01. Required for wildcard certificates, which HTTP-01 cannot issue. Off by default because it needs a DNS provider API token.

email.title: ACME account email
email.description: Required when enabled. Let's Encrypt uses it for expiry warnings.

apiTokenSecretRef.title: API token reference
apiTokenSecretRef.description: Reference to a Secret holding the Cloudflare API token. Placed out-of-band; never part of this blueprint.
